scenarios.criterion: errorRecorder MUST keep every formatted message passed to Errorf, not only whether a call happened.
scenarios.name: errorRecorder keeps the full text of every formatted error message
given: an errorRecorder test double stands in for the real test-reporting interface
when: Errorf is called on the recorder with a format string and arguments
then: the recorder stores the fully formatted message text
the recorder does not merely flag that a call happened, with the message text discarded

scenarios.criterion: TestVocabularyCheckCatchesAMismatch MUST assert exactly one mismatch was recorded, naming field status, the document, and value queued.
scenarios.name: Vocabulary check reports exactly one mismatch, naming the field, document, and extra value
given: a fixture document whose status vocabulary includes an extra value, queued, not present in vocabulary.go's status set
every other vocabulary field in the fixture (type, source, trust, finish, autonomy) matches vocabulary.go exactly
when: the vocabulary check runs the fixture document against vocabulary.go
then: the recorded message names the field status
the recorded message names the fixture document
the recorded message names the extra value queued

scenarios.criterion: Temporarily weakening assertVocabularyMatches's message MUST make the new content assertion fail; qa-report.md MUST record this and its reversal.
scenarios.name: Weakening the mismatch message breaks the content assertion, and reverting restores a passing suite
given: assertVocabularyMatches's Errorf format string is temporarily changed to drop its "only in" clauses
when: TestVocabularyCheckCatchesAMismatch runs against the weakened format string
then: after the format string is reverted to its original text, the full internal/intake suite passes again

scenarios.criterion: The full internal/intake suite MUST pass, every function's cyclomatic complexity MUST stay below 7, and no file outside internal/intake/ MUST change except this run's own delivery record.
scenarios.name: The internal/intake suite stays green, complexity-compliant, and scoped to its own package
then: every function in the changed test file has cyclomatic complexity below 7
no file outside internal/intake/ has changed, except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/vocabulary-mismatch-message/
